topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I'm sauntering into the college, the kind of place where the rain just makes the old brick more charming. This kid, supposed to be the brainy type, got caught with his hand in the cookie jar—word-for-word from a source he should've cited. I take a long drag of my cigarette, letting the smoke curl up in the damp air. Maybe it's the city, or maybe it’s the thrill of the chase, but something feels right about this gig. I smile as I think about the grad who’ll be spilling their guts by sundown. Cases like these—they’re not just about the truth; they're about the story behind the story. And I’m the only one who's gonna hear it.
